notes.title: Dashing New Update
notes.content:
We have taken our players feedback and released a patch making dashing even better. Dash through your enemies with ease, and fly through the air farther than ever. We've taken out the lack of friction so you can have precise control over your dashes as well.

We made a number of fixes for smaller bugs.

Thank you everyone for playing! SKOAL!
